property_summary: Only DAO-deployed curated pools can cause C to record positive mapSynth_LPBalance; non-curated callers (even DEPLOYER) must not increase mapSynth_LPBalance via mintSynth.
Only callers that POOLFACTORY::isCuratedPool(...) reports true can increase that pool's recorded LP balance via mintSynth.

mintSynth only increases mapSynth_LPBalance for caller pools that are recognized as curated pools by POOLFACTORY (i.e., mapSynth_LPBalance[pool] after mintSynth is greater than zero only if the caller is a curated pool), so when a caller is not reported as curated the recorded LP balance must remain zero.

After calling mintSynth as caller X, C.mapSynth_LPBalance(X) must increase by exactly the amount of LP tokens that C observed deposited (i.e., recorded LP balance equals previous recorded balance plus the detected added LP amount), for callers that are curated pools.
When mintSynth is called by a curated pool, the synth contract's recorded LP balance for that pool (mapSynth_LPBalance[pool]) strictly increases compared to its previous recorded value.

For any addresses a,b the reference contract C never changes any mapSynth_LPBalance entry when a view call allowance(a,b) is made; the mutant that relaxes onlyPool can cause allowance(...) (which calls no state itself) to be followed by external actions that let DEPLOYER mint LP-linked synths and thus change mapSynth_LPBalance for some pool, violating the invariant.

Calling allowance(...) (a view) never changes any mapSynth_LPBalance entry in the correct contract; the mutant that relaxes onlyPool allows DEPLOYER to act as a pool and after interacting via allowance-triggered actions can cause mapSynth_LPBalance(k) to change for some k.

Calling allowance(...) is a pure/view accessor and cannot change any mapSynth_LPBalance entry in the reference C for any inputs; the mutant relaxing onlyPool lets DEPLOYER act as a pool and (via subsequent pool-only actions) can make some mapSynth_LPBalance(k) differ after such interactions, violating the invariant.

For any addresses a,b the view call allowance(a,b) does not change any mapSynth_LPBalance(key) in the correct contract; the mutant that relaxes onlyPool permits DEPLOYER to behave as a pool and can cause some mapSynth_LPBalance(k) to change after an allowance call sequence, breaking the invariant.

Calling the view allowance(a,b) never changes any mapSynth_LPBalance(key) in the correct contract C for any inputs; the mutant that relaxes onlyPool allows DEPLOYER to act as a pool and can change mapSynth_LPBalance(k) after such sequences, so after calling allowance(...) the mapSynth_LPBalance for all keys remains equal to its prior value in the reference but can differ in the mutant for some inputs.
After a pool calls mintSynth(member, amount), the contract's recorded LPDebt for that pool increases exactly by the minted amount (mapSynth_LPDebt[pool] increases by amount).

property_summary: Calling C.mintSynth from a pool should not revert (i.e., it must always succeed) for any pool caller and any amount where the pool has nonzero added LP units.
When a pool with a positive added LP amount calls mintSynth(member, amount) with amount > 0, the call should not revert.
When a curated pool (caller) has a positive added LP amount, calling mintSynth(member, amount>0) must succeed (not revert).
For any pool caller that has strictly positive newly added LP units, calling mintSynth(member, amount>0) must not revert (i.e., the call succeeds).
